main_text.p: μεταςχάττος τῶ ὠοῦ ἐξ ἀήου τόπου εἰς ἀῆου A excludūt, ouo in aliū vteri locum ex alio τόπον τ' ὑςτέρας. μαλακώδιρμον ὃ τὸ ὠὸν καὶ ὁμόχροων ἔχει αὐτῆ. εἰς ἢ μόνος οὐ ζωοτο- κεῖ τῆς τοιούτων ἐν αὐτοῖς, ὁ καλούμενος βάτραχος · ἀεὶ οὖ τῶ αἰτίαν ὑςτέρον λεκ- τέον. εἰ ὃ ἀμφὶ ὀσοιαςπ ὠοτοκεῖσι τῆς ἰχθύων, μονόχερον μὴ φωλεύοντ τὸ ὠὸν, ἀπλῶς ὃ τῆτο.

transflato. Molle hoc ouū est,& vnicolor- Vnus ex iis animal nō parit,qui rana voca tur: cuius causam pōst exponā. Cæteri pi- sces, qui oua pariunt, ouum vnicolor e- dunt,quod imperfectum est: quippe quod extra capiat incrementum eadem causa, qua & quod intus perficitur. De vteris qua inter se differentia discrepent, & quas ob causas ita fit, declaratum est an- te. Viuiparorum enim alia supra, iuxta cinctum vterum continent: alia infra iux ta genitale. Supra cartilaginea habent: in- frà, quæ animal & intra se, & foras gene- rant, vt homo, equus, & reliqua generis e- iusdem.
{A} Greek column continues in the left column; the Greek text is set in Greek letters and reproduced only in summary here, as the scan is too faint to read reliably letter by letter.

page.notes: The Greek columns on the left are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the transcription of the Greek is incomplete and the remaining Greek lines are not reliably read.
